claim_scores.rationale: Builds `dspy.Predict(StringToInt)`, uses a 2-example dataset, and feeds one valid JSON completion plus one malformed completion via `RawSequenceLM`.
Asserts the first result is a normal parsed prediction and accesses `.number` successfully despite the later parse failure.
Asserts the malformed case returns a `FailedPrediction` and the run continues to produce both results.
Checks `results[1]["prediction"].completion_text == 'not json at all'`, preserving the exact bad text.
Asserts `len(results[1]["trace"]) > 0`, showing the failed example still records trace data.
